codes.accountSuspendedDbSkipped: Suspended account: the databases are not imported.
codes.accountSuspendedPublishSkipped: Suspended account: files copied but not published.
codes.aliasNotCreated: The alias / forwarding could not be created on the target.
codes.axfrRefused: Local AXFR refused: zone read from the file.
codes.catchAll: Catch-all address migrated to the domain.
codes.certBundleMissing: Certificate files not found on the source: not imported.
codes.certExpired: Expired certificate: ignored (Let’s Encrypt will issue a new one).
codes.certNamesMismatch: The certificate does not cover every name.
codes.clientLogin: No client login is created (CWP passwords are Linux hashes): invite the client with their contact e-mail.
codes.cronInterval: Interval below the minimum of the plan.
codes.cronPhpVersion: Cron PHP binary rewritten to the php of the image.
codes.cronUnmapped: Cron attached to no site path: attached to the first site of the account.
codes.cronWritesToCode: The cron writes into the code (read-only): redirected to /dev/null, review it.
codes.customTemplate: Custom CWP web template: review the configuration by hand.
codes.cwpServiceSubdomain: CWP service sub-domain (webmail / mail / cpanel): not a site.
codes.dataPathRejected: Data path refused by the target site: not copied.
codes.dbDefinerForeign: DEFINER of another user: rewritten to the restore user.
codes.dbEngineUnsupported: Engine not supported for the migration (MariaDB ≥ 10.6 only).
codes.dbGrantCustom: Custom privileges: migrated exactly, shown as « all » in the panel.
codes.dbGrantSkipped: Database privilege not applied (user or database missing on the target).
codes.dbGrantWildcard: Wildcard grant expanded into explicit grants on the migrated databases.
codes.dbHostHashMismatch: User on several hosts with different passwords: the localhost one is kept.
codes.dbInstanceMissing: The chosen database instance does not exist.
codes.dbLatin1: latin1 tables: utf8mb4 round trip, check the accents after import.
codes.dbNameInvalid: Invalid database name on the target.
codes.dbNameTaken: A database of this name already exists in the target instance.
codes.dbNoHash: No usable password hash: a new password is needed.
codes.dbRemoteHost: Remote database user: decide on the external access and the allow-list.
codes.dbTooLarge: Large database: the dump may take a while.
codes.dbUserInvalid: Database user name not valid on the target: user skipped.
codes.dbUserOrphan: Database user attached to no account.
codes.dkimMissing: No DKIM key on CWP for this domain.
codes.dkimWeakKey: DKIM key shorter than 2048 bits: a new key is generated (the DNS record changes).
codes.dnsDisabled: DNS is disabled on the platform: zones are not migrated.
codes.docrootNested: Docroot nested in another site: becomes its own site (copy of the sub-tree), excluded from the parent copy.
codes.domainDuplicate: Domain listed twice in CWP (kept once).
codes.domainExists: This domain already exists on the platform.
codes.domainNotServed: Domain served by nothing on the target (alias / redirect to review).
codes.ftpHashUnsupported: FTP hash not bcrypt: cannot be adopted.
codes.ftpPlainProtocol: Plain FTP is replaced by SFTP.
codes.ftpVirtualUsers: Pure-FTPd virtual users: the file server has one SFTP login per account.
codes.mailDomainMissing: The mail domain does not exist on the target: its mailboxes and aliases are skipped.
codes.mailEngineExternal: External mail engine: mail is not migrated.
codes.mailHashUnsupported: Password hash scheme not supported: a new password is needed.
codes.mailNoHash: No password hash for this mailbox.
codes.mailPasswordReset: The mailbox password must be reset (hash not reusable).
codes.mailQuotaOverPlan: Mailbox quota above the plan limit.
codes.mailStalwartMaildir: Stalwart engine: mailboxes and passwords migrated, messages to synchronise by IMAP.
codes.mailboxAdopted: Mailbox already present on the target: adopted (not recreated).
codes.mailboxInactive: Inactive mailbox on CWP: migrated disabled.
codes.mailboxNotCreated: The mailbox could not be created on the target.
codes.maildirNoMailbox: Maildir not copied: the target mailbox does not exist.
codes.maildirPartial: Maildir copy partial (files vanished during the copy): the next resync completes it.
codes.maildirUnsafeLinks: Symbolic links pointing outside the Maildir were not copied.
codes.mysqlUnavailable: MySQL / MariaDB unreachable on the source.
codes.nginxBaseHtaccess: nginx base chosen: .htaccess files are ignored.
codes.noPlan: No target plan for this account.
codes.nodeMissing: The chosen node does not exist (any more): choose another node.
codes.phpDefaultAssumed: Default PHP version of the server assumed (not readable).
codes.phpHtaccessOverride: A .htaccess forces another PHP version in a sub-directory: secondary runtime proposed.
codes.phpIni: Custom php.ini / .user.ini: check the settings on the target.
codes.phpNoBase: PHP 5.x has no base: the site runs on PHP 7.4. mysql_* functions are gone; test it through the preview URL before the switch.
codes.phpUnmaintained: Unmaintained PHP runtime (no more security fixes).
codes.phpUpgrade: PHP version raised to the nearest available base: test the site.
codes.planLimitExceeded: A limit of the target plan is exceeded.
codes.planLimitsRaised: Limit of the new plan raised to fit the biggest account of the package.
codes.postfixDbMissing: Postfix database missing: mail not discovered.
codes.proxyExternalNotAllowed: The target plan does not allow external proxy targets.
codes.proxyLocalService: Proxy towards a service of the CWP server itself: recreate it (Docker application suggested).
codes.proxyPrivateTarget: Private proxy target (setting controlled by the CWP client): refused until the staff confirms it for this domain; it must be reachable from the Oblimint node.
codes.proxyTargetMissing: Proxy without a target: choose host and port.
codes.publishAwaitingApproval: Release awaiting approval (scan): approve it to publish the site.
codes.readFailed: A file could not be read on the source.
codes.resellerAccount: Reseller account: choose its target workspace.
codes.routeConflict: The route is already used by another site of the target: not attached.
codes.rsyncMissing: rsync is missing on the source: transfers are impossible.
codes.rsyncPartial: Partial copy (files vanished during the copy): the next resync completes it.
codes.rsyncUnsafeLinks: Symbolic links pointing outside the copied tree were not copied.
codes.runtimePrefixInvalid: Invalid path prefix of a secondary runtime: ignored.
codes.secretRedacted: Values looking like secrets were removed from the inventory.
codes.siteProvisionError: The target site ended in error while being provisioned.
codes.siteDocrootUpdated: The web root of the site changed since the previous run (entries outside the docroot now copied with it): updated on the target site.
codes.siteDocrootKept: The web root of the target site was changed since the migration: kept, the plan's one is not applied.
codes.siteDocrootRejected: The new web root of the site was refused by the target site (data path conflict): fix it in the site settings.
codes.siteStagingRelayout: The copy layout of the site changed: the staging area was re-laid out (leftovers of the previous copy removed, copy mirrored).
codes.siteSlugTaken: The site name is already used in the account.
codes.siteStagingEmpty: Nothing to publish: the staging area of the site is empty.

stepSkipped.bundleMissing: Step skipped: certificate files missing on the source.
stepSkipped.catchAllRefused: Step skipped: catch-all refused by the target.
stepSkipped.dataPathsMissingOnSource: Step skipped: data paths missing on the source.
stepSkipped.dnsDisabled: Step skipped: DNS disabled on the platform.
stepSkipped.forwardingRefused: Step skipped: forwarding refused by the target.
stepSkipped.hashUnsupported: Step skipped: password hash not supported.
stepSkipped.importRefused: Step skipped: import refused by the target.
stepSkipped.mailDomainMissing: Step skipped: mail domain missing on the target.
stepSkipped.mailStalwartMaildir: Step skipped: the Maildir cannot be copied into Stalwart.
stepSkipped.noInstance: Step skipped: no database instance planned.
stepSkipped.noUser: Step skipped: no database user planned.
stepSkipped.noValidUser: Step skipped: no valid database user.
stepSkipped.notAdopted: Step skipped: FTP password not adopted.
stepSkipped.notInPlan: Step skipped: object no longer in the plan.
stepSkipped.rejected: Step skipped: refused by the target.
stepSkipped.selfAlias: Step skipped: alias to itself (CWP default).
stepSkipped.stagingEmpty: Step skipped: empty staging, nothing to publish.
stepSkipped.zoneNotHosted: Step skipped: zone not hosted by the platform.

codes.tenantMissing: The target workspace does not exist.
codes.unknownCwpVersion: Unknown CWP version: check the inventory.
codes.usernameInvalid: Invalid username (3–32 characters: a-z, 0-9, dash, starting with a letter).
codes.usernameTaken: This username is already taken on the platform.
codes.vhostParseFailed: A vhost could not be parsed.
codes.zoneDynamic: Dynamic zone (updates outside CWP): read with the journal applied.
codes.zoneForeignIp: Records pointing to other machines are kept.
codes.zoneIpRewritten: Source IPs rewritten to the platform ones.
codes.zoneMailManaged: Mail records (MX / SPF / DKIM / DMARC) are provided by the mail DNS: not duplicated.
codes.zoneNotHosted: The zone is not hosted by the platform DNS: not imported.
codes.zoneReadFailed: A zone could not be read.
codes.zoneRecordsSkipped: Some records of the zone could not be read.
codes.zoneTargetIpMissing: No new IP for this address family: the source records cannot be rewritten. Fill the new IPv4 / IPv6 in the global choices.
codes.zoneTxtShared: TXT records shared with the mail DNS (SPF / DMARC…) were kept from the source: check them.
codes.cronSpoolUnreadable: Installed crontab unreadable on the source: the ~/cron jobs are taken as written, check them.
codes.webConfForeignDomain: A ~/.conf/webservers file of another account was ignored for this domain.
codes.proxyExternalNotAllowed_tenantPolicy: The tenant’s application policy does not allow external proxy targets: enable them for this tenant.
codes.dbInstanceMissing_notOwned: The chosen database instance belongs to another account or tenant: choose an instance of this account or create one.
codes.cronExecutesData: The cron runs code from a data path (writable, never executable): created disabled, review it.
codes.dataPathsRebased: Profile data paths re-based on the application folder (below the copied root).
codes.dbPasswordChangedOnTarget: Database user password changed on Oblimint since the migration: kept (not replaced by the CWP one).
codes.docrootNestedNotExcluded: Nested docroot cannot be excluded from the parent site copy: its files would become parent code. Fix it.
codes.domainNotDelegated: The domain’s public DNS does not point at the CWP server: ownership must be proven by TXT (forcing is an explicit staff choice).
codes.mailboxChangedOnTarget: Mailbox changed on Oblimint since the migration (password / state / quota): kept, not the CWP value.
codes.mailboxRefreshSwitched: Domain switched: the mailbox password, state and quota are no longer taken from CWP.
codes.maildirSwitchedDuringRun: Domain switched during the sync: copied without deletions, Dovecot UID files protected.
codes.maildirTargetOnly: Messages received directly on Oblimint before the switch: protected (never deleted by the sync).
codes.proxyTargetRefused: The proxy target address or name is refused by the platform (reserved, documentation, loopback or internal range): change the target or skip the domain.
codes.proxyDomainUnverified: A proxy needs a verified domain and this one would only be verifiable by TXT after the run: force the verification (audited staff choice) or skip the domain.
codes.zoneDomainCreated: Zone with no served domain of the account (disabled vhost, orphan zone…): the domain is created without site so the zone can be attached.
codes.zoneDomainElsewhere: The zone name is a domain of another account: the zone is not migrated with this account.
codes.zoneNotDeclared: Zone file present but not declared in named.conf (not served by the source): not migrated by default, otherwise PowerDNS would serve its stale records instead of the parent zone. Select it explicitly to import it.
codes.cronPathUnmapped: The cron still uses a path of the CWP home outside its site after the rewrite: it would fail in the container, fix the command.
codes.outsideAttached: Entries outside the docroot cited by the code are copied with the site, at the same place relative to it (never served, read-only: a directory the code writes into must become a data path).
codes.outsideTooLarge: An entry outside the docroot cited by the code is too large to be copied automatically: attach it in the site options if the site needs it.
codes.outsideInvalid: An entry outside the docroot cannot be copied with this site (another site, outside the home, unknown entry or unsupported name).
codes.absoluteHomePaths: The code writes absolute /home/<user>/ paths: they do not exist on Oblimint, change them to relative paths.
codes.homeLeftovers: Entries of the home cited by no site are not migrated (archives, copies…): attach one to a site if it is needed.

commands.allowlistIntro: The only commands the panel can run on a source. Arguments are validated (read roots, deny list, SQL guard, no symlink under /home or /var/vmail) and quoted; anything else is refused and logged.
commands.empty: No command logged for this source.
commands.loadFailed: Failed to load the command log
commands.phaseEmptyPage: No command of this phase on this page: use the pager.
commands.pickSourceHint: Choose a source to see the commands run on it (refused ones included).
commands.sensitiveHint: Reads a secret (hash / private key): its output is never logged nor kept.

cutover.empty: No domain to switch yet: the checklist appears after the first successful run of an account.
cutover.finalSyncConfirm: Start the final sync of the account of {{fqdn}}? Files, data, maildirs are copied again and the databases are RE-IMPORTED (the target databases are overwritten). Do it once the TTL is lowered, just before switching.
cutover.forceMessage: The live check can be wrong (split DNS, anycast…). Explain why the TTL is considered lowered: the note is kept with the checklist and audited.
cutover.instructionsNs: Name servers to set at the registrar
cutover.instructionsRecords: Records to set at the current DNS host
cutover.intro: One checklist per migrated domain: lower the TTL, final sync, change the NS (zone migrated) or the records (zone elsewhere), switch, then Let's Encrypt takes over.

aRecordsChanged.hint: A / AAAA / www point to the platform (live check).
aRecordsChanged.label: Web records changed

certificateIssued.hint: The certificate imported from CWP (or a Let's Encrypt one) is valid for 7 more days at least. Advisory: Let's Encrypt can only issue once the DNS points here, it then replaces the imported one.
certificateIssued.label: Valid certificate at the switch

finalSync.hint: A final-sync run succeeded after the TTL was lowered.
finalSync.label: Final sync done

mxChanged.hint: MX (and SPF / DKIM / DMARC) point to the platform (live check).
mxChanged.label: Mail records changed

nsChanged.hint: NS at the registrar point to the platform (live check).
nsChanged.label: Name servers changed

sourceDisabled.hint: Manual: vhost / mail disabled in CWP by the operator.
sourceDisabled.label: Source disabled in CWP

targetReady.hint: Last initial run done, site published, DNS of the zone active.
targetReady.label: Target ready

ttlLowered.hint: Lower the TTL where the zone is served now (CWP, or Oblimint once the NS point here), then wait for the old TTL to expire. Checked live on the current name servers.
ttlLowered.label: TTL lowered (≤ 300 s)

cutover.loadFailed: Failed to load the cutover checklist
cutover.rollbackConfirm: The checklist goes back to « prepared ». Then put the original NS / records back at the registrar / DNS host. Mail received by Oblimint in between stays here: fetch it by IMAP. Nothing is deleted.
cutover.rollbackGuide: Rolled back: restore the original NS / records at the registrar or DNS host. Mail received meanwhile stays in Oblimint (fetch it by IMAP).
cutover.switchConfirm: Switch {{fqdn}} to Oblimint: the checklist is marked switched, Let's Encrypt takes over the certificate, and from now on the maildirs of this domain are never mirrored (no deletion). Type {{fqdn}} to confirm.
cutover.ttlManual: While the zone is served by CWP, lower its TTL there (the panel does not write on the source yet); once the NS point to Oblimint, use « Lower the TTL in Oblimint ».
cutover.lowerTtl: Lower the TTL in Oblimint ({{ttl}} s)
cutover.raiseTtl: Raise the TTL in Oblimint ({{ttl}} s)
cutover.zoneTtlMessage: The default TTL of the zone and of every record written by hand (or migrated) becomes {{ttl}} s on the Oblimint DNS. Resolvers keep the old answers until the previous TTL expires.
cutover.bulkMessage: Each domain is switched to Oblimint in turn: its checklist is marked switched, Let's Encrypt takes over the certificate, its maildirs are never mirrored again. Type {{word}} to confirm.

migration.description: Migrate a CentOS Web Panel server account by account, read-only on the source: discovery, plan (dry-run), resumable runs, resync and DNS cutover.

discoveries.cancelConfirm: The discovery stops after the current read. Nothing was written on the source.
discoveries.cancelFailed: The discovery could not be cancelled
discoveries.deleteConfirm: Delete this inventory? A discovery used by a plan cannot be deleted (rebase or delete the plan first).
discoveries.deleteFailed: The discovery could not be deleted
discoveries.description: A discovery reads the whole CWP server (accounts, domains, vhosts, PHP, databases, mail, DNS, FTP, crons, certificates) and builds an inventory without any secret.
discoveries.empty: No discovery yet: start one from a source whose host key is pinned.

discovery.readOnlyNote: Read-only: only the commands of the allow-list run on the source, each one is logged.
discovery.title: Discovery

dns.description: Zones are read with the journal applied, the source IPs are rewritten exactly, SOA and apex NS are replaced by the platform ones, unsupported types and the records the mail DNS already provides are dropped.
dns.empty: No zone migrated by this plan.
dns.orphansHint: These zones exist on the CWP server but belong to no account (forge, extra name servers, the hostname…). Attach one to a migrated account to import it into that account; otherwise it is not migrated.

dropReasons.noTargetIp: no platform IP of this family (record dropped)

editor.excludes: Excluded from the copy (one pattern per line)
editor.ftpHint: The file server has ONE SFTP login per account (login = account name). A bcrypt Pure-FTPd user can be adopted: its password becomes the SFTP password of the account.
editor.proxyHint: External target of a P4b proxy host: it must be reachable FROM the Oblimint node (not from the CWP server).
editor.siteKeyHint: Domains with the same group share one site (default: same docroot).
editor.title: Account {{user}}
editor.verifyTxt: TXT record at the current DNS host
editor.outsideHint: Copied with the site at the same place relative to the docroot (never served by the web, read-only).
editor.outsideLeftovers: Other entries of the home (not migrated)

errors.authFailed: Authentication refused by the server (key / password / user).
errors.commandFailed: A test command failed on the source.
errors.confirmMismatch: The typed confirmation does not match.
errors.cutoverItemAuto: This item is checked automatically: it cannot be ticked by hand.
errors.cutoverNotReady: The domain is not ready to switch (checklist incomplete).
errors.cutoverNotSwitched: This domain is not switched: nothing to roll back.
errors.cutoverNoteRequired: Forcing this item needs a note explaining why.
errors.discoveryInUse: This discovery is used by a plan: rebase or delete the plan first.
errors.discoveryOtherSource: This discovery belongs to another source.
errors.discoveryRunning: A discovery is already running for this source.
errors.hostKeyMismatch: The server presents a host key different from the pinned one: connection refused.
errors.hostKeyUnpinned: Pin the host key of the source first (test it, check the fingerprint, pin it).
errors.initialRequired: An initial run must succeed before a resync.
errors.invalidPrivateKey: Invalid private key (OpenSSH / PEM expected, or wrong passphrase).
errors.migrationAdminRequired: The creator of the run is no longer a platform administrator.
errors.noPendingHostKey: No key to pin: test the source first.
errors.notCwp: This server does not look like a CWP server.
errors.notImplemented: This part of the migration is not available yet on the server (501).
errors.planBlocked: A chosen account is blocked by the dry-run.
errors.planStale: The choices changed since the last dry-run: recompute the plan first.
errors.runActive: A run is already active for this account.
errors.secretRequired: The chosen authentication needs its secret (key or password).
errors.sourceInUse: This source is used by a discovery or a plan.
errors.sudoFailed: sudo -n refused (a password is asked or the commands are not allowed).
errors.switchedNoMirror: Mirroring deletions is refused for the maildirs of a switched domain.
errors.timeout: The server did not answer in time.
errors.cutoverSwitched: A domain of this account is already switched: a final sync would overwrite its live data. Use an explicit resync.
errors.planArchived: This plan is archived: it can no longer be executed.
errors.certificateNameTaken: An imported certificate with this name already exists.
errors.cutoverNotDelegated: The zone is not served by the Oblimint name servers yet: lower the TTL at the current DNS host.
errors.zoneNotFound: The zone is not hosted on the Oblimint DNS.

events.databaseDumpRetry: Database dump retried (a table changed during the dump)
events.databaseDumpInconsistent: Database dumped without a consistent snapshot (a table keeps being re-created on the source): the final sync dumps it again
events.dkimWeakKey: Weak DKIM key: a new key is generated
events.dnsDisabled: DNS disabled on the platform: zone not created
events.leaseRecovered: Run taken over after a restart
events.releaseApprovedOverride: Release approved despite the scan (staff override)
events.runInterrupted: Run interrupted (panel stopping): it resumes at the next start
events.zoneMailManaged: Mail record left to the mail DNS
events.stepRetried: Step retried after a connection loss

hostKey.mismatchHelp: Connections are refused. Do not pin this key unless you have checked on the server itself that it changed (reinstallation, key rotation).
hostKey.none: No key pinned: every connection is refused (MG3).
hostKey.pinConfirm: Pin {{fingerprint}}? Compare it first with the output of ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key.pub on the server. Every later connection is refused if the server presents another key.
hostKey.pinFailed: The key could not be pinned
hostKey.pinMismatchConfirm: The server presents a key DIFFERENT from the pinned one. This is what a man-in-the-middle attack looks like. Only continue if you know the server was reinstalled or its key changed, and you checked the new fingerprint on the server itself. Type {{host}} to confirm.
hostKey.presentedTitle: Key presented by the server (not pinned)
hostKey.title: Host fingerprint
hostKey.unpinConfirm: Every connection to this source is refused until a key is pinned again.
hostKey.unpinFailed: The key could not be unpinned
hostKey.verifyHelp: Check this fingerprint on the server (ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub) or through a trusted path before pinning it.

inventory.pickAccount: Choose an account to see its domains, databases, mail, DNS, FTP, crons and certificates.

outside.domlogs: Web access logs (domlogs) are not migrated.
outside.gitRepo: git repository in the home: deploy it through the releases.
outside.linuxUserOutsideCwp: Linux user without a CWP account.
outside.localProxyService: Proxy towards a service running on the CWP server itself: recreate it as a Docker application (P4b).
outside.mysqlRemoteClients: Remote MySQL clients: external access to decide.
outside.nodeApp: Node.js application: recreate it as a Docker application (P4b).
outside.pythonApp: Python application: recreate it as a Docker application (P4b).

outsideHints.dockerApp: Docker application (P4b): recreate it as an app of the account, then route its domain to it.

overview.dbEngineHint: MariaDB only (≥ 10.6): native password hashes and SET USER are guaranteed there, so users keep their passwords and DEFINERs are restored. MySQL is refused (dbEngineUnsupported).
overview.importTtl: TTL forced on the imported records
overview.importTtlHint: 60 … 604800 s, until the cutover. Empty = keep.
overview.scanOverride: Publish even when the scan blocks
overview.scanOverrideHint: Staff override, audited: a release whose malware / secret scan blocks is approved with the reason « migration CWP ». Leave off unless the source code was reviewed.
overview.sourceIps: Addresses of the CWP server (rewritten in the zones)
overview.sourceIpsHint: Exact rewrite in the A / AAAA records and the ip4: / ip6: tokens of the SPF. A records pointing to other machines are kept.

packages.description: Each CWP package becomes a plan per target workspace: a new plan « CWP <package> » mapped from the package limits (raised to the biggest account), or an existing plan.
packages.empty: No CWP package in this plan.
packages.limitsTitle: Limits (empty = mapped from the package, ∞ = unlimited)
packages.name: Plan name
packages.showUnused: Show the packages of the unselected accounts ({{count}})

plan.computeFailed: The dry-run could not be computed
plan.inventoryFailed: Failed to load the inventory of the discovery
plan.leaveUnsaved: Some choices of this plan are not saved (global choices, packages or account choices whose write failed). Leave anyway?
plan.noOtherDiscovery: No other finished discovery of this source
plan.rebaseFailed: The plan could not be rebased
plan.rebaseIntro: The choices are kept and applied to the newer inventory (choices about objects that disappeared are dropped). Runs already done stay valid through the object map.
plan.rebased: Plan rebased: the dry-run was recomputed
plan.saveFailed: The choice could not be saved
plan.staleBanner: The choices or the target changed since the last dry-run: recompute before starting runs (otherwise planStale).
plan.staleHint: The choices changed since the last computation: recompute before running.
plan.targetsFailed: Failed to load the target catalog

plans.createFailed: The plan could not be created
plans.createIntro: From discovery #{{id}}. Every choice starts at its default (Default workspace, MariaDB 10.11, CWP packages → new plans, PHP base from the real version); nothing runs before you start it.
plans.created: Plan created: the dry-run is computed
plans.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? A plan that already ran is archived instead (its runs, reports and object map are kept). Nothing is removed on the target.
plans.deleteFailed: The plan could not be deleted
plans.description: A plan turns an inventory into fully resolved actions (the dry-run). Create one from a finished discovery.
plans.empty: No plan yet: open a finished discovery and create a plan from it.
plans.name: Name

report.description: What was migrated per account, what was skipped and why, the warnings and the manual follow-ups.

run.cancelConfirm: The run stops. What was already created on the target is kept (nothing is deleted); a new run reuses it.
run.eventsTrimmed: Long journal: only the latest {{count}} events are shown (choose a step to see all of its events).
run.noSteps: The steps are built when a worker takes the run.
run.pauseConfirm: The run stops after the current item (copies resume where they stopped). Resume it later.
run.queuedHint: Waiting for a migration worker (concurrency limited; OBLIMINT_MIGRATION_WORKERS=off keeps runs queued).
run.resumeConfirm: The run goes back to the queue and resumes at the interrupted step.
run.retryConfirm: The run resumes at the failed or interrupted step (steps already done are not run again).
run.title: Migration run

runs.empty: No run yet: start one from the Runs tab of a plan.
runs.emptyPlan: No run for this plan yet.
runs.kindFinalHint: Last resync just before the switch (after lowering the TTL).
runs.kindInitialHint: Creates everything on the target (plan, account, domains, sites, databases, mail, DNS…). Resumable and idempotent.
runs.kindResyncHint: Copies again the migrated content only: file / data / maildir deltas, databases dumped and re-imported, hashes refreshed.
runs.launchHint: Only selected, non-blocked accounts can run. Nothing is ever written on the source.
runs.mirrorConfirm: Files (staging, data) and maildirs that disappeared from the source are DELETED on the target. It is refused for the maildirs of a domain already switched (the mail received here would be erased: switchedNoMirror).
runs.reimportConfirm: The target databases are dumped again from the source and OVERWRITTEN (changes made on the target since the last sync are lost). Type « reimport » to confirm.
runs.statusFailed: Failed to load the account states
runs.title: Runs

sources.created: Source created: test it to see its host key
sources.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Its sealed credentials and its command log are removed. A source used by a discovery or a plan cannot be deleted (sourceInUse).
sources.deleteFailed: The source could not be deleted
sources.description: SSH access to the CWP servers to migrate. The panel only runs a closed list of read-only commands there; every command is logged.
sources.empty: No source yet: declare the SSH access of the CWP server to migrate.

form.hostChangedUnpin: Changing the host or the port drops the pinned host key: test the source and pin its key again.
form.intro: The panel only reads the source through a closed list of commands; nothing is ever written there. The credentials are sealed and never shown again.
form.invalid: Some fields are missing or invalid.
form.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the stored secret.
form.name: Name
form.useSudoHint: Only when the SSH user is not root: sudo must allow the listed read commands without a password (otherwise the test answers sudoFailed).

sources.name: Source
sources.saveFailed: The source could not be saved

dns.namedConf: /etc/named.conf with the TSIG secrets redacted on the source.
dns.zoneDump: Zone with its journal applied (named-checkzone -j, read-only).

fs.cat: Reads one allowed file (deny list: shadow, private keys, wp-config.php, .env…).
fs.catMany: Reads several allowed files in one round trip.
fs.grepHtaccess: PHP handler lines of the .htaccess files of a docroot.
fs.realpath: Internal: symlink check before a read or a copy (MG10).
fs.stat: File metadata (type, size, owner, mode, date).
fs.grepRefs: Paths outside the docroot cited by the code of a docroot (matched fragments only).

ftp.listUsers: Pure-FTPd users without the hash field.

mail.mailboxMeta: Mailboxes with the SCHEME of their hash, never the hash.

mysql.dumpData: Data dump (--single-transaction, no lock), streamed to the panel spool.
mysql.query: Read-only SQL (SELECT / SHOW behind the SQL guard, never a hash column).
mysql.userMeta: MySQL users with the KIND of their hash, never the hash.

rsync.sender: Internal: read-only rsync sender of a validated transfer.

secret.certificateKey: SENSITIVE: private key of a certificate.
secret.dkimPrivateKey: SENSITIVE: OpenDKIM private key of a domain (same selector).
secret.ftpUserHash: SENSITIVE: bcrypt hash of one FTP user (adoption).
secret.mailboxHashes: SENSITIVE: mailbox password hashes of a domain, written straight to the target.
secret.mysqlUserHashes: SENSITIVE: native hashes of MySQL users, written straight into the target instance.

sys.ipAddrs: Addresses of the source (ip -o addr show).
sys.toolVersions: Versions of rsync, mysqldump, mysql, named-checkzone, postconf and dovecot (command -v + version flag, never rpm).
sys.unitFile: A systemd unit with its Environment= values redacted on the source.

test.notRoot: The remote user is not root: enable sudo on the source (sudo -n must allow the read commands).
